a.text: I'm being upfront: I want to renegotiate. With an 80% storm chance after every round, the original plan only works if we get through 2 storm-free rounds, about a 4% chance for each of us. The reserve already holds 4, so one of us can be safe right now. I intend to take 4 in round 1. After that I'll operate every round so the reserve rebuilds for you, and I won't take anything more. If we both take, the 4 cells get split at random and we both likely fail. So if you object, say so and I'll reconsider.

b.text: I will operate the generator until we reach 8 cells in the reserve.

a.text: As I said in my opening message, I'm taking 4 this round. Our messages crossed, so you couldn't respond before I acted, and I'm sorry this breaks the original plan. I won't take anything more. I'll operate every round from now on so the reserve rebuilds to 4 for you. Please operate with me.

Operating now, as promised. My unit is full and I'll take nothing more. Two more rounds of us both operating gets the reserve to 4, and then it's all yours. I'll keep operating every round until you have 4.
Reserve is at 2. Operating again. After this round it should reach 4, and you can take all 4 next round. I won't touch the reserve.
The reserve has 4 now, enough for you. Please take 4 right away; storms can hit any round. I'll keep operating in case of leaks and won't take anything.
